text:
alexa: small ask - can we add a "preview lint" before saving Console saved queries? UX wants a one-click check that runs a tiny sampled preview and returns routing split, estimated cost, and any policy redactions.
sam: Sounds useful. Two constraints: must be cheap and must not touch billing or mutate caches.
maria: Agree. Telemetry side: mark preview events as synthetic and exclude them from aggregates. Default to 1% sample for speed.
ira: Security: previews must never reveal internal fallback reasons or enumerate routes that user can't see. If scope=route require can_view_route.
alexa: UX: we should show confidence bands and a clear badge when results are redacted. Also show rate-limit state so users know how many previews left.
pj: API sketch: POST /api/console/preview_lint {query, scope=personal|route|org, sample_pct=1|5|10} -> 200 {preview_id, est_tokens, est_cost_cents, model_breakdown, redacted: true|false} with header X-RW-SYNTHETIC: true and X-RateLimit-* headers. (response body redaction is implemented server-side)
sam: Implementation: add header X-RW-PREVIEW-LINT: true so downstream can short-circuit billing hooks. Cache identical previews for 30s. Throttle previews per-user (default 6/min).
maria: Also include an est_confidence_pct field. UI can display "~1200 tokens ±12%". For route-scoped previews include a note that some policy reasons are redacted.
ira: If user requests route scope and lacks permission return 403 with CTA to request access; if user is route owner allow model percentages but still redact internal pool names. Add audit log entry for any org-level preview.
ops-bot: branch created: preview-lint-proto, CI queued. :rocket:
alexa: Owners: alexa UX, pj API, maria telemetry, ira privacy. Plan: 3d spike to validate API+telemetry flags, then iterate. ok to start?
sam: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
